annotations.title: Add a recipient to the distribution list

description: Use this when the person explicitly asks to add a customer's e-mail address to their distribution list. Adds one address to the distribution list of the connected account, for all products or for the given ones, as "Abnehmer eintragen" does in the dashboard without "jetzt zustellen". No mail is sent; the first delivery is started in the dashboard. Refuses an address that is already on the list. Only add people who are customers of the account holder. Do not use to send anything or to add people who are not customers of the account holder.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

mail_language.description: ISO 639-1 language of the delivery mails: de, en, fr, it, nl, pl, cs, sk, hu, sl, hr, ro, es, pt, da or sv. Default: the language of the manufacturer page

product_ids.description: Only these products; default all products
